notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Addressing Your Feedback
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We would like to thank everyone for sharing their thoughts and ideas for Munch VR. The response has been overwhelming and we are always happy to hear your constructive feedback on Munch!

We have created an update for the game to address as much of your input as possible. Of course there will be more to expect in the future.

[list]
    [*]Added an option to hide the motion controllers.
    [*]Added more variation in the Munch sound effects.
    [*]Added props and foliage to create prettier environments.
    [*]Fixed fish visibly spawning out of thin air.
    [*]Fixed fish swimming through the terrain.
[/list]

Thank you again and happy munching!

notes.title: Experimental Linux Support
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Munch is now available to try on Linux systems using the SteamVR for Linux beta release. Both the full game and the demo is available, but beware that due to the staggering amounts of beta software used to develop and play VR on linux, this is an experimental release and we give no guarantees that it will work on your system. This is also the reason why the store page won't list Linux and SteamOS as a supported platform.

We thank you for your support and hope that everything works well for you.

Happy Munching
Victor

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone[/h1]

We know you've been waiting for a long time but the is about to come to a close. The journey has been longer than we originally thought and the path has been littered with hurdles. But today we can finally announce that Munch will be released on the [b]17th of February 2017[/b] around 14 o' clock PST(UTC-8). That's right, only 3 weeks from now.

We thank you for your patience and your support during the last few months since we announced Munch and hope you will enjoy the game on February 17th.

Kind Regards,
Victor

notes.title: Oculus Demo available
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone[/h1]

As of a few minutes ago the demo has been updated with a version supporting the Oculus Rift + Touch, and you will be asked which version you want to run when clicking play. 

The main difference apart from hardware is that the Oculus version focuses the playfield in front of you instead of all around. 

If you have the opportunity, please try both versions and tell us which one you prefer!

Happy Munching
[i]Victor[/i]

notes.title: HTC Vive demo now available for download!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hooray![/h1] 
You can finally try out the very first publicly available version of Munch. Just click the PC Demo download button on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/549000]store page[/url] and start munching!

[h1]Want to help us create Munch?[/h1]
We need test pilots that help us shape and design the game. Only you, the player, know what makes fun and interesting gameplay. [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfyb2odgeC1yCuVy9xSLybMUq7jy-efM3VKV_DjAKmWr74cmQ/viewform]Apply to join our closed tester group[/url] on Discord with exclusive access to the latest builds and direct contact with us developers!

[h1]It's just a prototype![/h1]
Please remember that the demo isn't representative of the final game. We will change some stuff, add other stuff, probably even remove some stuff before we're finished! 

All I'm saying is don't judge us too early. We do appreciate any and all feedback though! Please apply to the tester group or send me an email at alexander@mostlyharmless.games if you want to send some feedback or suggestions, just don't write anything mean <3

Take care!
[i]Alex[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26774903/249cd5b7227d2128b752765fe15d6c86467d6c82.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcing Munch
notes.notes:
Hello!

This is Alex. I'm the CEO of Mostly Harmless Games. Me and my four colleagues are making this game, and it's my pleasure to be announcing it to the world.

The game is currently in early production, meaning there's a lot more content and many changes to come before the game is released.

Now, we want to work as close as possible to our community and we would love it if you stuck around during our development process. You can Follow and Wishlist the game to stay updated on our progress :)

More announcements regarding test groups and demos and stuff will come very soon! Until then, take care <3

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26774903/5b12e772685a67bae95edc04abdf225dbfa84c4e.png[/img]
